verdict.rationale: Docs mention that async inference results can be delivered via webhook callback, showing Baseten supports webhook-based notification for job completion, but there is no dedicated webhook subscription system (event types, signing, retry, subscription management) described anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: a general event-subscription/webhook API or docs page (event catalog, signature verification, delivery guarantees), coverage beyond async-inference completion notifications, and any independent confirmation of webhook reliability.
